newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils close lower despite Chicago rall.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils close lower despite Chicago rall.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices closed lower on Wednesday despite the rally in early trading in Chicago soy futures.
"We were half expecting a rally because soy futures were looking oversold, however most people are now waiting to see how it closes," said one trader.
Earlier traders said the market would try to consolidate but would remain on the defensive until Chicago shows some definite signs of bottoming out.
At the close soy oil was 0.25 to 0.50 guilders down while rape oil was 0.75 to 1.25 guilders lower.
Lower prices attracted some interest with bargain hunters jumping in at the lower levels.
Soy oil traded at 104 guilders for Jul while 103 and 103.50 was paid for Aug/Oct and 100, 100.50 and 100.75 guilders a 100 kilos paid for Nov/Jan.
Dutch/EU rape oil traded outright at 101.50 guilders for Aug/Oct while Aug/Oct also traded at 102 guilders in a switch with Nov/Jan at even money.
Crude palm oil closed unchanged to $2.50 lower while products were $2.50 to $5 lower, unchanged from midday.
Lauric oils were neglected with coconut and palmkernel oil unchanged to $2.50 down.
